create_crystal_industry.ponder.budding_g: Budding Blocks only advance their growth when a random tick lands on them. Random ticks are rare, and each one only has a small chance to advance a stage.
Accelerators change that: each tick, they force a random tick onto every block they touch.
Some Budding Blocks add their own requirements: Echo needs darkness, Flammable Ice needs water, Fluix needs AE power, and Quartz and Glowstone only grow at full speed in the Nether.
create_crystal_industry.ponder.accelerat: Accelerators come in two types. This Electric Accelerator runs on FE; the Mechanical Accelerator runs on Rotational Force.
Supplying it with FE starts it: every tick, one random tick is forced onto each neighbouring block.
This Mechanical Accelerator runs on Rotational Force, taken at its back.
The slower the input spins, the fewer random ticks it applies each second. At low speed a stage still takes a while.
Raise the input speed and the same stages complete in moments.
Random ticks drive far more than crystal growth. Crops, saplings and every other random-tick mechanic are accelerated as well.
All six sides are ticked at once, so one Accelerator serves everything around it.
create_crystal_industry.ponder.smart_dri: The Smart Drill is a Mechanical Drill with two harvesting modes. This scene covers Normal Harvesting.
In Normal Harvesting the Smart Drill mines twice as fast as a regular Mechanical Drill.
The setting slot on its side switches harvesting modes.
Silk Touch Harvesting mines at the speed of a regular drill: both drills break the block at the same moment.
Budding Blocks are a special case: a regular drill shatters them, and the block itself cannot be collected.
In Silk Touch Harvesting the Smart Drill collects the Budding Block itself.
create_crystal_industry.ponder.cleaner_a: The Mechanical Cleaner drives the same airstream as an Encased Fan.
Items caught in its stream, or simply lying in front of it, are sucked in and stored in its built-in inventory.
create_crystal_industry.ponder.cleaner_c: A container placed directly in front is handled specially: the Cleaner moves items in and out of it directly, without dropping anything into the world.
While collecting, it reaches into that container and pulls matching items into its own inventory.
While blowing, stored items are fed back into the container in front.
Blowing or sucking, filters and transfer amounts are all configured through its interface and the side slot.
The side slot reverses the airstream, and the Cleaner starts moving items the other way.
create_crystal_industry.ponder.resonance: The Resonance Table
A Resonance Table can only ever hold one kind of item.
Right-Click to place an item on a Resonance Table, and Right-Click again to take it back.
The sliders on its sides set how many items a Resonance Table may hold, just like the Weighted Ejector.
Configuring the Filter with Several Tables
Sneak-Using a Resonance Table copies its network onto the held item.
Every table placed from that item joins the same network, and they filter together.
A table holding nothing is simply left out of the filter.
Only when every table of the network is empty does it pass everything.
Automating the Filter
A Resonance Filter holds no rules of its own: it reads the Resonance Tables of the network it is linked to.
Only what the network allows will pass.
Change the item on the Resonance Table, and the filter follows at once.
List and Attribute Filters
A Resonance Table also accepts a List Filter, and passes every item that filter holds.
An Attribute Filter on a table is read the same way, and passes whatever its attributes match.
Freezing the Filter
Supplying Redstone Power to a Resonance Table freezes its filter.
The network keeps filtering by a copy of the item that sat there when it was powered.
Remove the signal and the filter follows the Resonance Table again.
Reading a Network on a Display
A Display Link attached to a Resonance Table reads the filter of its entire network.
The link sends that list to the Flap Display it points at, one item per line.
The list covers every Resonance Table of the network, so a second Resonance Table adds a second line.

create_crystal_industry.configuration.fl:
1-in-N chance per eligible deep-ocean chunk that a flammable ice budding structure generates.
Higher = rarer.
create_crystal_industry.configuration.so:
Whether soul sand generates near flammable ice budding structures.
The soul sand sinks into the seafloor and sends up bubble columns.
create_crystal_industry.configuration.ac:
Ticks between two acceleration passes.
1 = every tick (default); larger = slower.
Both accelerators scale with it, and the electric one pays its energy cost per pass.
The Goggles multiplier follows this value too.
create_crystal_industry.configuration.bu:
Whether budding blocks infect their neighbours: stone growing into ore, a raw metal block being turned into a new budding block, the Echo block spreading sculk, all of it counts.
Turning this off stops budding blocks from converting anything at all (so they no longer multiply themselves either).
create_crystal_industry.configuration.in:
Which budding blocks infect their neighbours.
Empty = all of them may; a non-empty list = ONLY those may, the rest stop converting anything.
List family ids (raw_iron, quartz — the same id as worldgen.generate_<id>) or block ids (kubejs:my_crystal_budding, which scripted budding blocks need).
Does nothing while the switch above is off.
create_crystal_industry.configuration.gl:
Chance (0.0–1.0) that a naturally generated glowstone cluster gets its lowest block replaced with glowstone budding.
0.0 = never, 1.0 = every cluster.
Whether glowstone budding also spawns a few glowstone buds/clusters on its side faces.

Number of buds/clusters spawned around each naturally generated glowstone budding block.
0 = none.

Whether glowstone buds also generate on nearby glowstone blocks around the budding block.
If false, buds only appear on the budding block's own faces.
create_crystal_industry.configuration.sc: Scan radius of the Echo Spyglass, in blocks.
Interval between two scans, in ticks.
create_crystal_industry.configuration.ma:
Maximum number of blocks returned per scan.
Prevents huge network packets from overly broad filters (e.g. stone).
create_crystal_industry.configuration.go: Overall opacity of the night vision goggles screen overlay (0.0 = invisible, 1.0 = fully opaque).
create_crystal_industry.configuration.cl:
Whether items play the fly-into-the-cleaner animation when the Mechanical Cleaner sucks them in.
Visual only: items enter the internal inventory at the same instant either way.
Mechanical Cleaner: Drops Go Straight In

Whether drops appearing inside a sucking Mechanical Cleaner's airstream go straight into its inventory instead of spawning as item entities.
Saves entities in farms; the item ends up in the same place either way.
Anything that would not be picked up right away (inventory full, filtered out, or a washing/smelting airstream) still spawns normally.
